description: Defines base classes and templates for datasets in the Torch data module, including BatchDataset, Dataset, and StreamDataset, with related utilities and type traits.

classes.name: BatchDataset
classes.description: A dataset class that yields data in batches, possibly stateful, with virtual methods for batch retrieval and size.

classes.name: Dataset
classes.description: A dataset class inheriting from BatchDataset, providing random access to individual examples and batching.

classes.name: StreamDataset
classes.description: A template alias for a potentially infinite stream dataset, yielding batches based on a size_t index.

methods.name: get_batch
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve a batch of data given a BatchRequest.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Pure virtual method to return the size of the dataset, or empty if unsized.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Template method to create a MapDataset applying a transformation to this dataset.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve a single example at a given index.

methods.name: get_batch
methods.description: Default method to retrieve a batch of examples given a list of indices by calling get() for each index.
